rules_for_llm_builder: Do not build a custom UI library from scratch.
Use Zustand for global app state.
Use Expo SQLite for users, habits, reflections, and pattern data.
Do not add fake AI, Apple sign-in, Google sign-in, Firebase, or provider-dependent flows.
Use react-hook-form and zod for onboarding and habit forms.
Use react-native-svg for vector assets and charts.
Keep all UI driven by the design system JSON.
Do not hardcode spacing, colors, typography, or radius inside screens.
